mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM SEB100 T1 , SEA200 T2 , SCA100 X , SEB150 Y , SAA000 Z , SEB510 T5 , SDA100 T6 , AFA330 T4 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO AND Z.INST_NO = Y.PIC_INST_NO AND X.ENFSN_NO = Y.CASE_PIC_NO AND Y.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' AND Y.CASE_MNG_NO = T1.CASE_MNG_NO AND Y.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T5.CASE_MNG_NO = T1.CASE_MNG_NO AND T5.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T5.RESRCE_NO = T6.RESRCE_NO AND T5.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T6.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD NOT IN ('01') AND T4.CASE_MNG_NO = T5.CASE_MNG_NO AND T4.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T5.CASE_MNG_ODRNO

SELECT /* isry.aimns.casemng.mapper.AimnsCaseMngMapper.caseinqListCount */ count(*) FROM SEB100 T1 , SEA200 T2 , SCA100 X , SEB150 Y , AFA330 T3 WHERE 1=1 AND T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO AND X.ENFSN_NO = Y.CASE_PIC_NO AND Y.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' AND Y.CASE_MNG_NO = T1.CASE_MNG_NO AND Y.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = T3.CASE_MNG_NO(+) AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO(+)

choose.when: /* 진행일자 조회 */ AND T1.CASE_BGNG_YMD <= #{END_DATE} AND NVL(T1.CASE_TRMN_YMD, T1.CASE_BGNG_YMD) >= #{START_DATE}

sql.if: AND T1.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD IN (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD' AND UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE = #{CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD})

otherwise.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SEB150 YY WHERE 1=1 AND T1.CASE_MNG_NO = YY.CASE_MNG_NO AND T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = YY.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND YY.PIC_DSGN_YMD <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AND YY.CASE_PIC_NO = #{ENFSN_NO} )

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SEB510 B, SDA100 C, SDA420 D, SDA400 E WHERE B.CASE_MNG_NO = T1.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND C.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO AND D.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AND E.SRVC_BIZ_NO = D.SRVC_BIZ_NO AND E.BIZ_YR = #{BIZ_YR} )

if.test: COMPL_BGNG_YMD != null and COMPL_BGNG_YMD != '' and COMPL_END_YMD != null and COMPL_END_YMD != ''

sql.if: AND T3.BGNG_YMD <= #{COMPL_END_YMD} AND (T3.END_YMD >= #{COMPL_BGNG_YMD} OR T3.END_YMD IS NULL)
